name: create_notification
description: Create a quiet notification for routine updates, workflow findings, or completed tasks. Examples: 'notify me that cleanup succeeded', 'send this update to my phone'. Saves notification history and queues configured channel delivery without creating an alert or spoken follow-ups. Use create_alert for an actionable problem needing alert management. A queued notification is not confirmation of phone arrival. Keep messages brief and omit credentials or raw private tool responses.

message.description: Brief text retained in local history and published as supplied to requested channels. Omit secrets and raw private responses.

source.description: Origin such as cleanup_all or github_ai_radar. Defaults to manual.

channels.description: Configured delivery channels. Defaults to ntfy; an empty list saves history only. No credentials, URLs, or destinations are accepted.

dedupe_key.description: Stable occurrence identity shared across retries, such as a release version or job run ID. Use a fresh key for a new occurrence.

max_age_seconds.description: Delivery freshness limit, default 3600 seconds. This is separate from history retention.
